documents.title: Proceeding Of 3Rd Annual General Meeting Held On 31 July 2026
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM
Board Meeting Outcome for Standalone And Consolidated Financial Results For The Quarter Ended June 30,2026

analysis.summary: Chembond Chemicals Limited reported consolidated revenue of Rs. 326.15 crores for FY26, representing a 12% growth over the previous year. The company recorded its highest quarterly revenue of Rs. 101.4 crores in Q4 FY26, driven primarily by strong performance in the water technologies segment. Management noted rising raw material costs following geopolitical conflicts and metal price increases, impacting near-term profitability.

guidance.claim: The company maintains a positive outlook on revenue growth, though earnings face profitability challenges.
guidance.quote: Revenue outlook continues to remain positive. However, on the earnings, profitability is a little bit of a challenge right now.

guidance.claim: Chembond foresees a volume growth of around 15 to 20% in construction chemicals for quarter one of the year.
guidance.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

guidance.claim: Water chemicals volume growth is expected to be roughly around 10%.
guidance.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

demand_outlook.claim: All business units possess strong sales pipelines with a positive sales growth outlook.
demand_outlook.quote: All of these businesses are having strong sales pipelines and we see that the sales growth outlook looks positive across all these business units.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is experiencing significant growth in sealants through its polysulfide and PU sealant products.
demand_outlook.quote: Sealants, we are seeing a significant growth and we intend to consolidate our presence in that segment through our polysulfide and PU sealants.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to deploy funds towards network growth and geographical expansion.
capex_expansion.quote: We intend to deploy some of it in network growth and geographical expansion.

capex_expansion.claim: In Thailand, Chembond has added new accounts and is growing its team.
capex_expansion.quote: In Thailand, we've been able to add new accounts, new customers. So that's a segment where we also are growing our team.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested ₹90.76 lakhs during FY 2025-26 towards the installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at Dudhwada, Gujarat.
capex_expansion.quote: ₹90.76 lakhs were invested towards installation of the 350 kVA solar renewable energy plant at the Dudhwada, Gujarat manufacturing site during FY 2025-26.

margins_costs.claim: Full-year FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 51 crores, reflecting a 7% increase year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA for the full financial year is at Rs.51 crores, up 7% over prior.

margins_costs.claim: For FY26, EBITDA margin was 14% of sales and profit after tax was 10% of sales.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA is 14% of sales and profit after tax is 10% of sales.

margins_costs.claim: Material costs began increasing from late February and March, driven by volatility in key metals like zinc and molybdenum.
margins_costs.quote: Material costs started increasing from March, end of Feb, March. A lot of volatility in metals before that. So some key materials that we use are based on metals, so zinc and molybdenum and stuff like that.

orders_capacity.claim: Chembond is entering the new financial year with a strong order book for its chemicals business.
orders_capacity.quote: So we are starting this financial year with a strong order book for our chemicals business also.

orders_capacity.claim: Water technologies segment volume increased by 50% in the second half of the year to 4,813 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: So 50% increase in terms of volume for our water business and most of this is carrying forward.

capital_allocation.claim: Days sales outstanding for construction chemicals stood at around 88 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: We are maintaining a tight credit policy and our day sales outstanding for construction chemicals is around 88 days as on 31st of March 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has around 65 crores of cash/balances on its books.
capital_allocation.quote: Yes, we have around sixty-five crores on books.

capital_allocation.claim: Days sales outstanding for the distribution business stood at roughly 80 days as of March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: So here also we are maintaining a tight credit policy with days sales outstanding at 80 days, roughly as on 31st of March 2026

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 per equity share aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board has recommended a final dividend of ₹1.25 (Rupee One and Paise Twenty-Five only) per equity share of ₹5 (Rupees Five only) each, aggregating to ₹336.20 lakhs for the financial year ended March 31, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: Public sector units comprise about 30% of the water business and had not accepted force majeure declarations until the government declared it.
risks_headwinds.quote: About 30 percent of our total business in the water business comes from public sector units, and none of them had accepted a force majeure until the government just declared it two weeks ago.

risks_headwinds.claim: A prolonged monsoon impacted construction activity and sales in the second quarter.
risks_headwinds.quote: In first half year, our quarter two was slow on account of monsoon, but yes, quarter three and quarter four picked up.

management_commitments.claim: Chembond foresees around 15 to 20% volume growth in construction chemicals in quarter one.
management_commitments.quote: Coming to quarter one of this year, we foresee around 15 to 20% of volume growth in construction chemicals.

management_commitments.claim: The company anticipates around 10% volume growth in water chemicals.
management_commitments.quote: Water chemicals, it would be roughly around 10%.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
